answer: Every identity stakes 70 credits, filing one signed claim on a basalt tablet. The ocean registry checks each slot, so an agent that tries to forge two rival claims is caught when one crystal seal shows up twice and both burn. First claim 38 credits, kth 38+7(k-1): a thousand fakes burn 3,534,500 chasing a 40,000 pool; rented seals fail, each binding its renter's key. An honest identity spends 38 once and gets its stake back after one clean epoch.
